title: 2Advanced Studios v3 flash website in 2001
summary: A short archival capture of the 2001 Flash website of 2Advanced Studios, an agency known for high-end Flash design. It is part of the Web Design Museum's collection of early web design.
why: HN commenters link it as nostalgic proof of how inventive and formative the Flash-era web was.

quote.text: 2A made me completely rethink media and interaction.
